customerOutcome: Review recorded task ownership and current work status, with bounded Native worker inspection for current administrators.
entryConditions: Current verified Human account and active company membership; instance administration cannot substitute for membership.
Current Original task/read authority is required for each projected plan. Native administrator admission separately controls inspection and Pause/Stop.
Progressive shell and Native orchestration rollout admit the index. The exact safety control and own request-receipt routes survive rollout withdrawal.
exitConditions: Current recorded plan state is separate from independently verified output.

Explicit Pause/Stop is committed by the Original plan decision owner with its existing durable supervision stop queue. A receipt proves admission, not physical propagation or reversal of completed effects.
The bounded index does not claim a complete inventory or prove absence of older or hidden plans.

content.supportingCopy: A plan status alone does not verify its output.
displayedState: Current Native task title, owner and recorded assisting Agent assignments; unknown assignments remain unknown.
Current Original plan status and version, distinct from output verification.
Only current Native administrators receive worker assignments, declared joins and plan limits; members receive no topology or budget object.
Inspect is an explicit disclosure. Pause, Stop and any manual continuation retain their Original control/task owners.

At most 21 recent candidate plans are checked, with at most 20 authorized results. More-items information counts only confirmed authorized records. An empty bounded view does not prove a complete empty inventory.

inputs.help: On the exact-plan safety page; completed effects remain
inputs.validation: Select one Native control action and bind the exact plan version
inputs.autofillOrPrefill: None; held only in memory for the current account and Source

inputs.help: Record a concrete reason for the Native control receipt
inputs.autofillOrPrefill: None; held only in memory for the current account and Source

inputs.label: I understand completed actions remain
inputs.help: Stopping prevents further admitted work; it does not undo completed effects
inputs.validation: Must be explicitly checked before a new command
inputs.autofillOrPrefill: None; held only in memory for the current account and Source

primary.label: Review the current task
primary.operation: Open the exact Original authorized task; no execution or mutation occurs.

secondary: Inspect current coordination after Native administrator admission
Open current Pause/Stop controls for the exact Original plan
Open Original control surface after current administrator admission
destructiveOrIrreversible: Explicit Pause/Stop requires current Native administrator/root-task authority, reviewed plan version, 20–2000 character reason and acknowledgement that completed effects remain.

canonicalReadDomains: Original orchestration plans, workers, attempts and complete current Task/run Source checks.
Current verified user, active company/membership, Native task/Agent readers and Original administrator admission.
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: The separate safety page calls the Original plan CAS decision inside its existing transaction; the original supervision outbox and body-free idempotent Activity receipt commit atomically. No second planner, dispatch or queue is created.
systemWork.authorityEffect: Read projection cannot grant permissions or imply a passing result.
systemWork.asyncWork: Existing request admission bounds four in-flight requests and a 1500ms deadline; underlying unfinished work keeps its admission slot until settled. Privacy locks and PostgreSQL statement/lock timeouts bound composition.
systemWork.receipt: Current observed timestamp and Native IDs/version/status only; no Human/provider or execution qualification is manufactured.

states.loading: Announce a current read while identity or Source is being checked; private prior rows are withheld.
states.empty: No authorized result in this bounded scan; never a complete empty inventory.
states.partial: Missing actor assignments remain unavailable; oversized, malformed or unstable Native metadata makes the read unavailable rather than a truncated complete tree.
states.stale: Withhold private rows during current-account, company or Source rechecks. Display the timestamp of the last confirmed read and provide explicit refresh.
states.validation_error: Index has no editable plan inputs. Safety control validates the exact current version/action, valid reason and effect acknowledgement before retaining a locator or making a POST; invalid/foreign scopes are refused.
states.system_error: Announce current work status unavailable, omit raw errors and offer a current private read retry.
states.permission_denied: Withhold private rows and inspection; no grant is inferred from navigation or a profile label.
states.recovering: Index refreshes current read. Safety control retains a content-free original request locator before one POST; lost acknowledgement/reload permit Original receipt GET only. Missing receipt stays unconfirmed; no mutation or execution is replayed.
states.success: Display confirmed Native ownership, recorded plan state and current administrator metadata. This is neither an execution-start nor an independently verified-output receipt.

navigation.back: Use the canonical shell navigation or exact Original task link.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: This read-only page saves no input or plan.
navigation.deepLink: /orchestration; Advanced entry requires current server-confirmed administrator admission. /orchestration/:planId/control remains mounted after rollout withdrawal.
navigation.resume: Fetch current Source after a return, account change or invalidation. No private status is placed in browser persistence. Safety recovery retains only a content-free per-tab request locator and repeats current Native control admission before showing a receipt.

accessibility.initialFocus: Focus the current page heading after first confirmed read only when no utility/navigation/input gesture is already active.
accessibility.focusAfterError: The read failure uses an announced alert and labelled retry. Background updates do not steal utility focus.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: The first confirmed read may focus the heading through the existing utility-aware focus owner; inspection leaves focus on its disclosure button. There is no mutation-success receipt.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Ordinary labelled links, refresh and disclosure buttons. Enter/Space opens inspection; no topology canvas is required.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Current loading/read failure uses status or alert. Recorded plan completion is explicitly separate from verified output.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: Task ownership/status and administrator worker assignments, states, declared dependencies and limits are ordinary text/list content. Disclosure controls reference a stable hidden/visible section.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow task/Agent names, inspection and limits with readable text and no hidden critical controls.
responsive.mobile: Links and buttons retain minimum touch targets; text/list inspection wraps within the viewport.

dataShown: Current authorized task title, Agent display names and recorded plan state.
Administrator-only allow-listed worker and budget metadata.
dataCollected: A control rationale is submitted only to the Original decision owner; browser persistence retains a per-tab account/company/plan/request locator without rationale or action.
sensitiveFields: Completion criteria, invariants, instructions, prompts, results, worker keys, manifests, credentials, raw errors and arbitrary properties are excluded.
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: The entire experience/orchestration namespace, including malformed scopes and refused methods, omits query identity, object/customer prose and raw errors from generic HTTP logs.

prohibitedPayloads: Intent, prompts, customer prose, raw errors, credentials, URLs, DOM and screenshots

functional: Verify actual Native creation/read without new runs, audits or model calls; current member/admin separation; actual recorded assignments and missing owners; flag/current-account/membership withdrawal; Source-erased bound attempt suppression without inventing physical plan deletion.
Verify strict no-store client scope, foreign/late-response rejection, English/Danish disclosure, current-source DOM withdrawal and explicit bounded empty state.

Actual PostgreSQL CAS, replay, changed-command refusal, current-role rollback and flag-withdrawn control reads are covered by focused software tests. Full effective delegation/action/tool/memory inspection, proportional takeover, native dynamic handoff selection and physical kill/revocation propagation acceptance remain pending.
accessibility: Verify keyboard/focus/announcements and 200/400% zoom manually on the exact artifact.
securityPrivacy: Current verified account/company, active membership and exact Native plan/root-task administrator control authority are required. Foreign account/plan/request responses are refused.
Control replay reads its immutable body-free receipt and cannot repeat Stop. Lost acknowledgement and reload allow Original GET recovery only; absence cannot prove no write.
A late authority withdrawal rolls back the plan, Original stop outbox and Activity journals. No model dispatch, schedule or permission grant is created by the experience.
usability: Use representative exploratory and pre-registered confirmatory journey evidence with explicit PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; source checks are insufficient.
